_comment: selectSeries unit readings over the synthetic line universe declared in series_cli_test.go (gemma, gemma-4, gemma-4.1, grok-build-0.1, llama-4). Exercises the family / major-union / line readings, the dashed-family split, and the negatives — without depending on the real catalog. Expected is the rendered line names in SeriesAll order. See TESTING.md.

provenance.ref: the line reading: a selector equal to a line's display rendering resolves, so copy-pasting a listing row always works

mutation.description: the selector is exactly one line's rendering, and that family has no dotted siblings to union

provenance.ref: the family reading, including the bare line whose rendering equals the family name — the union across readings is what stops 'gemma' hiding the bare gemma line

mutation.description: the selector is a family name that is also a bare line's rendering

provenance.ref: ruled: where a family has BOTH a bare-N line and N.x siblings, the union includes the bare line

mutation.description: the selector names a bare-integer generation that is simultaneously its own line and a union

provenance.ref: the narrow rung: a fully specified generation is a union of one, never the whole major

mutation.description: the selector's generation gains a minor part, which must exclude the bare gemma-4 sibling

provenance.ref: selectors arrive from a shell and must not be case- or whitespace-sensitive

mutation.description: the selector is upper-cased and padded

provenance.ref: grok-build is a real family whose name contains a dash; splitting on the LAST dash would read the family as 'grok-build-0' or the version as 'build-0' and miss

mutation.description: the selector's family segment itself contains the separator, so a last-dash parse would resolve wrongly

provenance.ref: the same dashed family reached by its exact line rendering

mutation.description: the full dotted generation is given rather than the major

provenance.ref: the family reading on a dashed family name

mutation.description: no version is given, so only the family reading may fire

provenance.ref: the mandatory dot: 'gemma-41' must not reach gemma-4.1 by string prefix

mutation.description: the dot is removed from a real line's generation, which must break the match rather than widen it

provenance.ref: a version the family does not spell is a normal negative

mutation.description: the version is changed to one no line carries

provenance.ref: an unknown family matches no reading

mutation.description: the selector names a family absent from the universe

provenance.ref: the empty selector is the no-argument listing path and must never resolve to lines here

mutation.description: the selector is emptied, the degenerate input a careless prefix test would treat as universal
